metadata.title: How to Find Favorite Songs in Melivra | Android Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
To find favorite songs in Melivra, open Lists and look under Smart Playlists for Favorite Songs. The same screen includes 5-Star Songs and 4-5 Star Songs.

Still-screen guide using real Android app screenshots with an original demonstration library. No taps, playback, file import, save result, or speed demonstration is shown.

Explore Melivra for Android:
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onnellab.melivra

#Melivra #OfflineMusicPlayer #Shorts

render_requirements.frame_review: All three full output frames must be visually checked for text width, legibility, full screenshot fit, crops and disclosure before upload.

execution_blocker.details: The available dot cloud browser supports UI interaction but not execution of the repository Python validator/renderer. Connected tools expose no non-CLI Python/Pillow/ffmpeg contract runner. Plugin search found no installed matching renderer; uninstalled AI/video services are not a verified cost-free execution route. Current scope prohibits CLI and separate Work/Codex, Remote and paid services.
execution_blocker.required_capability: An explicitly permitted bounded dot-cloud execution of existing Python/Pillow/ffmpeg/ffprobe for contract tests, verification and rendering, or an existing supported equivalent that executes the same checks.
execution_blocker.resolution: Owner explicitly authorized free dot-cloud Melivra production/test execution. No paid service or separate Work/Codex task used.

validation_test_plan: Accept only reviewed Melivra app/channel/locale/source revision/version and exact source PNG hashes/paths.
Reject changed bytes, unreviewed PNG, duplicate/missing assets, traversal and symlink paths.
Reject a wrong channel or cross-app reuse of the Quivra or Melivra contract.
Reject changed copy, unsupported success/performance/playback claims, missing persistent still-screen disclosure, narration/music or extra links.
Reject fake exact release-build attestation, unreleased-platform CTA and recording/upload-attestation flags.
Reject geometry drift from exact 1080x2400 Melivra source dimensions; uniformly fit complete screenshot without cropping.
Keep every existing Quivra positive/negative regression and all managed-recording safety gates unchanged.
Verify all output frames, silent 15-second 1080x1920 H.264/yuv420p/30fps MP4, bound hashes, and no owned encoder process left running.
